packages.name: cpp-jwt
packages.description: JSON Web Token library for C++
packages.guix_notes: Header-only C++ JWT library. Uses cmake. Depends on nlohmann-json (available in Guix as 'nlohmann-json') and openssl (available in Guix). Straightforward cmake packaging.

packages.name: crandpass
packages.description: A random password generator for Linux
packages.guix_notes: Simple bash script password generator. Just needs to copy the script to bin. Upstream repo is from an archived/deleted user (kitsuneflame-zz). Very simple to package but upstream may be dead.

packages.name: uhubctl
packages.description: Control USB per-port power switching on PPPS smart USB hubs
packages.guix_notes: Simple C program with plain Makefile. Depends on libusb (available in Guix). No configure script, just make. May need to pass PREFIX=/usr and use gnu-build-system with custom phases to skip configure. Straightforward.

packages.name: disktype
packages.description: A utility to detect the content format of a disk or disk image
packages.guix_notes: Very old but simple C program (version 9, last updated ~2006). Uses plain Makefile, depends only on glibc. Custom license. Hosted on SourceForge. Extremely simple to build, just needs custom phases for Makefile install. Very old/unmaintained upstream.

packages.name: retroforth
packages.description: A modern, pragmatic Forth
packages.guix_notes: Self-contained Forth implementation in C. Uses plain Makefile. Source is from forthworks.com. Depends only on glibc and bash. Should be straightforward to package with gnu-build-system and custom Makefile phases.

packages.name: ffmpeg-audio-thumbnailer
packages.description: A minimal audio file thumbnailer for file managers
packages.guix_notes: Shell script thumbnailer that wraps ffmpeg. Just needs to install the script to bin and the .thumbnailer file to share/thumbnailers/. Depends on ffmpeg (available in Guix). Very simple.

packages.name: zcfan
packages.description: Zero-configuration fan control for ThinkPad
packages.guix_notes: Tiny C program for ThinkPad fan control. Uses plain Makefile, no dependencies beyond glibc. Needs to interact with /proc/acpi/ibm/fan (ThinkPad-specific sysfs). Only useful on ThinkPads. Very simple to build. Needs a systemd service file equivalent for Guix (shepherd service).

packages.name: shstatus
packages.description: A simple statusline generator for i3bar and swaybar
packages.guix_notes: Bash script status bar generator. Just needs to copy script(s) to bin. Optional deps include coreutils, procps, pulseaudio tools, wireplumber. Simple copy-build-system package.

packages.name: ebsl
packages.description: A shell-accessible configuration file format
packages.guix_notes: Small C project using cmake. Depends on gzip at runtime. AUR lists base-devel and cmake as runtime deps which is incorrect; they are build-time deps. Simple cmake project.

packages.name: patchy-bin
packages.description: A CLI for generating and applying patches to git repositories
packages.guix_notes: Pre-built binary CLI tool. For Guix, should ideally build from source. Upstream appears to be a Node.js/TypeScript project (uses pkg to bundle). Building from source would require Node.js build toolchain. As binary: simple copy but non-reproducible. As source build: MEDIUM difficulty.

packages.name: orbit-bin
packages.description: A cross-platform task runner for executing commands and generating files from templates
packages.guix_notes: Go binary. For Guix, should build from source using go-build-system. Upstream is a Go project. Go packaging in Guix requires vendoring or importing all Go module dependencies which can be tedious but mechanical. MEDIUM difficulty due to Go dependency management.

packages.name: finalmouse-cli
packages.description: CLI tool to set Finalmouse polling rate on Linux
packages.guix_notes: Small C project using cmake. Depends on hidapi (available in Guix). AUR incorrectly lists cmake as runtime dep. May need udev rules for device access. Niche hardware tool but simple build.

packages.name: wdisplays-git
packages.description: GUI display configurator for wlroots compositors
packages.guix_notes: Wayland display configurator using meson. For Guix, use the stable 1.1 release tag instead of -git. Depends on gtk3, libepoxy, wayland, wayland-protocols (all available in Guix). Standard meson build. Note: wdisplays (non-git) may also exist in AUR as a separate package.

packages.name: fortty
packages.description: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator written in Fortran
packages.guix_notes: Fortran-based terminal emulator using cmake. Requires gfortran (available in Guix via gcc with fortran support). Depends on glfw, freetype, fontconfig (all in Guix). Unusual language choice (Fortran) but cmake build is standard. MEDIUM due to Fortran compiler requirement needing special gcc configuration.

packages.name: vvdec
packages.description: Fraunhofer versatile video decoder (H.266/VVC)
packages.guix_notes: H.266/VVC video decoder from Fraunhofer HHI. Uses cmake, minimal dependencies (just glibc). Provides libvvdec shared library. Straightforward cmake build. Well-maintained upstream.

packages.name: path-utils
packages.description: Useful shell rc PATH management tools
packages.guix_notes: Simple shell utility scripts for managing PATH in shell rc files. Just copy scripts to appropriate location. Very low complexity, very niche utility.

packages.name: commitlint-go-bin
packages.description: A lightweight, fast, and cross-platform CLI tool for linting Git commit messages
packages.guix_notes: Go binary for commit message linting. For Guix, should build from source using go-build-system. MEDIUM difficulty due to Go dependency management. Depends on git at runtime.

packages.name: tartrazine-bin
packages.description: A Crystal reimplementation of the Pygments/Chroma syntax highlighters
packages.guix_notes: Written in Crystal language. Guix has no Crystal compiler packaged, so building from source is INFEASIBLE currently. Binary-only packaging is the only option. As binary: simple copy. As source build: INFEASIBLE (no Crystal in Guix).

packages.name: picsort-bin
packages.description: A simple tool to sort your pictures using only your keyboard
packages.guix_notes: Go binary for photo sorting. For Guix, should build from source using go-build-system. MEDIUM difficulty due to Go dependency management.

packages.name: bab-bin
packages.description: Task runner for defining project commands in YAML
packages.guix_notes: Go binary task runner. For Guix, should build from source using go-build-system. MEDIUM difficulty due to Go dependency management.

packages.name: nexttrace-bin
packages.description: An open source visual route tracking CLI tool
packages.guix_notes: Go binary traceroute alternative. For Guix, should build from source using go-build-system. Uses CGO and depends on libpcap. MEDIUM difficulty due to Go dependency management and possible CGO requirements.

packages.name: amalgo-bin
packages.description: CLI tool for creating single-file snapshots of multiple code files
packages.guix_notes: Go binary for code file amalgamation. For Guix, should build from source using go-build-system. Pure Go, no CGO needed. MEDIUM difficulty due to Go dependency management.

packages.name: nvidia-gpu-exporter-bin
packages.description: Nvidia GPU exporter for Prometheus using nvidia-smi binary
packages.guix_notes: Go binary Prometheus exporter for NVIDIA GPUs. Requires nvidia-smi at runtime (from proprietary NVIDIA drivers). For Guix, could build from source using go-build-system, but runtime dependency on nvidia-smi makes it impractical in pure Guix environments. HARD due to proprietary driver dependency.

packages.name: briar-desktop-bin
packages.description: Briar secure messenger desktop client (beta)
packages.guix_notes: Java/Kotlin desktop app distributed as a JAR. Requires Java 17 runtime. Building from source would require Gradle + Kotlin + Compose Multiplatform toolchain which is extremely complex. The JAR contains native libraries (JNI). HARD - building from source is nearly infeasible; JAR-only packaging requires wrapping with java-runtime.

packages.name: python-stringzilla
packages.description: SIMD-accelerated string search, sort, hashes, fingerprints, and edit distances
packages.guix_notes: Python C extension library with SIMD optimizations. Uses setuptools. Has C/C++ source that compiles during install. Depends on glibc and python. Standard pyproject-build-system should work. The C extension code uses CPU-specific SIMD intrinsics (SSE/AVX/NEON) which may need architecture-specific handling.

packages.name: 7zip-docs
packages.description: HTML documentation for the 7-Zip file archiver
packages.guix_notes: Documentation package - just HTML files extracted from the 7-Zip source tarball. For Guix, would typically be an extra output of the 7zip package rather than a separate package. Simple copy of DOC/ directory. Depends on 7zip being packaged (it is in Guix as 'p7zip' or '7zip').

packages.name: popsicle
packages.description: Linux utility for flashing multiple USB devices in parallel, written in Rust
packages.guix_notes: Rust GTK3 application from System76/Pop!_OS. Uses cargo build system. Depends on gtk3 (available in Guix). Requires vendoring Rust crate dependencies. Includes both CLI (popsicle_cli) and GTK GUI (popsicle_gtk). MEDIUM - standard Rust packaging complexity with crate vendoring.

packages.name: xboxdrv
packages.description: Userspace Xbox gamepad driver and input remapper
packages.guix_notes: Userspace Xbox controller driver. Fork by xiota, uses meson (migrated from scons). Depends on dbus-glib, python, libusb, libx11 (all in Guix). Uses a specific git commit rather than a tagged release. MEDIUM - needs to pin a commit, and the dbus-glib + python runtime deps add complexity. Popular package (272 votes).

packages.name: marimo
packages.description: A reactive Python notebook that's reproducible, git-friendly, and deployable as scripts or apps
packages.guix_notes: Large Python project with many dependencies. Several deps likely missing from Guix: python-loro, python-narwhals, python-msgspec, python-pymdown-extensions, python-itsdangerous. Uses uv/hatchling as build backend. Also bundles a frontend (JS/TS) that needs to be pre-built. HARD - many missing Python deps and bundled JS frontend.

packages.name: dupe-krill
packages.description: An incremental file deduplicator to replace files with identical content with hardlinks or reflinks
packages.guix_notes: Rust CLI tool for file deduplication. Uses cargo build system. Minimal runtime dependencies (just gcc-libs). Standard Rust packaging with crate vendoring. Well-maintained upstream by a prolific Rust developer (kornelski).
